name: The Sparklematic 5200!
summary: Deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan sits the Sparklematic 5200, an automated cleaning contraption designed to scrub toxic filth from recovered salvaging. Operating the machine strips heavy grime from soiled objects and packages whatever is salvaged in a decorative gift box.

sections.title: Automated Cleansing
sections.body: Gnomish engineering often prizes efficiency and whimsy in equal measure. The Sparklematic 5200 was built to handle toxic and contaminated refuse, scouring away grime and caustic residue through automated cycles. Once loaded and paid, the contraption rattles through its cleaning routine before emitting a cheerful ding, neatly wrapping whatever remains into a present tied with a bow.

sections.title: Treasure in the Sludge
sections.body: Since the fall of Gnomeregan to the troggs and the subsequent radiation disaster, countless personal effects and technological scraps were smothered in industrial mire. Adventurers who feed grime-encrusted objects into the machine can reclaim lost gemstones, raw ores, and long-lost valuables that were swallowed up when the city was vented.

faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200 is an automated cleaning machine inside Gnomeregan. When supplied with a grime-encrusted object and a coin fee, it cleans away sludge, grime, and radioactive muck, returning the cleaned contents packaged in a small gift box.
The machine is located inside the interior corridors of the fallen city of Gnomeregan, near the Clean Zone where survivors and automated decontamination systems once operated.

faq.q: Why does the machine wrap items in a bow?
faq.answer: It was programmed with typical gnomish whimsy. Even after scrubbing dangerous fallout and toxic grime off an item, its creators designed the finishing cycle to package the restored object into a pleasant, neatly tied present.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers use the Sparklematic 5200?
faq.answer: Yes. The Sparklematic 5200 is a fully automated apparatus that does not care about faction allegiances. So long as a visitor inserts coins and soiled items, the machine runs its cycle.

faq.q: Can I use the Sparklematic multiple times?
faq.answer: Yes. After the initial operation, the machine unlocks a repeatable task allowing anyone who discovers grime-encrusted items throughout the dungeon to process them again and again.
Completing this initial cleansing leads directly to the repeatable cleaning cycle known as More Sparklematic Action, allowing you to clean any additional grime-encrusted finds you carry.

angles.text: The Sparklematic is a stark reminder of home before the fall: even an industrial scrub unit had to chime cheerfully and deliver the finished product wrapped up like a birthday present.
Studying the Sparklematic offers a look at automated particulate cleaning and rapid packaging mechanisms engineered to endure heavy ambient radiation.
